learning.optimizer: plain SGD, each group globalnorm clip1, no momentum
learning.home_tail: At active528, sum original full rewards529..terminal * gamma**(k-529), bootstrap0; never update on home controls. Original invalid last active terminal bootstrap0, no crossreset.
learning.actor_gate: strict delta=y-V_before(phi)>0; sign only, not magnitude weighted. Compute both gradients and mask before either update.
learning.actor_objective: 0.5 mean_over_all_512(sum_j(positive_delta_mask*(mean-requested_boxaction)^2)), denominator512 even if few positive. All nonpositive -> actor unchanged/count unchanged.
learning.value_objective: 0.5 mean((V-y)**2), semi-gradient only through current V
learning.allowed_data: only current round new active transitions from 25 training paths
learning.forbidden_data: prior round, old data, independent smoke, baseline, detcheck, final/fallback, teacher/external actions
learning.variant_disclosure: bounded neural actor, minibatch current-round processing, fixed counts, SGD/globalnorm clipping and terminal/home-tail handling are this finite variant, not original online paper implementation or CACLA+Var
learning.structural_distinction: State V TD + positive-TD self-action reinforcement. No policy gradient/log-density objective, Q network/NAF/L/P, LSTD projected solve, E-step/Gaussian MLE/KL/FisherCG/backtrack, model dynamics, external teacher BC or whole-policy perturbation. Actor loss has ordinary regression gradients, not 'no actor gradients'.
